devdoc.details: This contract must receive OPERATOR_ROLE on LendingMarketController and TokenVault. It intentionally has no arbitrary-call or asset-rescue function. Revoke both roles after use.

executeAdditionalPosition(bytes32,bytes3.details: Position replay protection intentionally lives in this orchestration contract.

params._fundingAmount: Net asset shortfall to deposit, not the gross corrected PV.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

executeAdditionalPosition(bytes32,bytes3.notice: Moves one incident counterparty's assets and the matching fee FV to recovery.

executeAssetTransfer(bytes32,address,add.notice: Transfers all current FV and GV positions and the remaining Deposit for one user and currency.

executeCorrections(bytes32,address,bytes.notice: Applies offsetting fills for one user and currency.

userdoc.notice: Executes the one-time correction for orders affected by the order-book incident.
